asA: shelf consumer relying on the composition to gate magic-link mint attempts
iWant: a magic-link mint POST that carries no Turnstile response, or a mint POST whose Turnstile response fails siteverify, to be refused with 400 before the mint fires
soThat: no magic-link is minted for a submitter who did not complete a Turnstile challenge
title: T-5 magic-link guard cross-cutting: a magic-link mint submit without a valid Turnstile token is refused with 400 before the mint fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to /api/magic-link on the pack fixture without a Cf-Turnstile-Response field, and a POST carrying the always-fail response token, are both refused with 400 by the Turnstile guard and no magic-link is minted. The Playwright pack check AC-turnstile-magicLinkGuard drives this against the fixture with a real browser.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with both blueprints applied and a real Playwright browser driving the fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: a magic-link mint submit is issued without a Turnstile response, or with the always-fail response token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Turnstile guard refuses with 400 and no magic-link mint side-effect is observable
